description: This file defines a validation pipeline behavior for MediatR requests, using FluentValidation to validate requests before passing them to the next handler.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior for MediatR that validates requests using a collection of FluentValidators.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Validates the request and either throws a ValidationException if validation fails or proceeds to the next handler.
